name: S Remind
description: An offline Android app for reminders, notes, habits, Flow focus sessions, and privacy-focused tools.
detail: S Remind brings reminders, notes, habits and focus sessions together in an Android app designed for offline use.

sections.heading: Reminders and calendar
sections.body: Browse a calendar and organize reminders into Today, Upcoming, Completed and Overdue views. Create reminders to keep track of everyday tasks.

sections.heading: Notes and Secure Vault
sections.body: Keep notes together, browse and search them, and access a Secure Vault area intended for cards, passwords and private details.

sections.heading: Habits and progress
sections.body: Track habits and personal goals, view streaks and journey or analytics screens, and record activity over time.

sections.heading: Flow focus sessions
sections.body: Use a focus and break timer, keep quick tasks nearby, and see session counts and focus time for the day.

sections.heading: Milo assistant
sections.body: Milo includes voice reminder and smart scanner options, along with shortcuts to tasks, notes and a timer. Milo is being improved: voice and scan results can contain mistakes and should be reviewed before saving.

sections.heading: Availability
sections.body: S Remind is in development. The features described here are based on the current app preview; release details and download links will be added when available.

name: S-tech
short: A simpler way to keep an eye on your money.
description: An offline Android money manager and personal finance tracker.
detail: S-tech is designed to help organize personal finances on Android. It is in development, and official release information will be added here when available.

name: S-Craft Tools
short: PDF, image, video & more useful tools.
description: Free browser-based PDF, image, text, video, audio, time, and number utilities.
detail: S-Craft Tools brings everyday file and utility tools together in one browser-based workspace. Choose a tool, add a file when needed, adjust its options, and save the result.

sections.heading: PDF tools
sections.body: Merge, split, compress, organize and rotate pages, add watermarks, add or remove a known PDF password, convert images and PDFs, and add a visible signature.

sections.heading: Image tools
sections.body: Resize, crop, compress and convert images; add text or watermarks; rotate, combine or sign images; and remove metadata.

sections.heading: Video and audio
sections.body: Trim, compress, convert and adjust media. Video tools include crop, resize, rotation, speed, merging and audio extraction; audio tools include volume, fades, looping and noise reduction.

sections.heading: Text, time and numbers
sections.body: Count and clean text, compare versions, use timers and date tools, or work with percentages, units, estimates, statistics and number conversions. Currency conversion uses a rate you provide.

sections.heading: A workspace that remembers
sections.body: Browse or search the collection, save favorite tools, and use Quick Access and Recent Activity to return to your work. These preferences are stored in your browser.

sections.heading: On-device processing
sections.body: The tools are designed to process files on your device. Browser media tools load a processing engine when needed; large or complex files can be limited by the browser and device. The full privacy review is ongoing.

sections.heading: Open source
sections.body: The public source is available on GitHub. Project-owned code is licensed under AGPL-3.0-only; third-party components have their own notices and licenses.

name: S Learn Auto
short: Learn industrial automation, step by step.
description: A self-paced learning platform for industrial automation, with a structured roadmap, practical projects and study resources.
detail: S Learn Auto helps learners move from electrical foundations toward industrial control systems through a structured, self-paced roadmap.

sections.heading: A learning roadmap
sections.body: Follow 46 learning phases, starting with electrical fundamentals, electrical drawings and control devices, then progressing through motors, sensors, instrumentation, PLCs, HMI, drives, industrial networks, SCADA and commissioning.

sections.heading: Study and track progress
sections.body: Explore phase checklists and progress tracking, use flashcard quizzes, and revisit the topics you want to practice. Interactive study tools require JavaScript.

sections.heading: Connect theory with practice
sections.body: Browse practical automation project ideas and learning resources to connect concepts with simulations or training-lab practice. Review the project scope and equipment instructions before starting.

sections.heading: Who it is for
sections.body: The roadmap is designed for self-paced study, whether you are beginning with electrical concepts or building knowledge of industrial control systems. It does not replace formal qualifications or equipment-specific instructions.
